Angewandte Chemie International Edition | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in an electronic polarization induced coordination (EPIC) strategy using an in situ [AlCl₂(BZA)₂]⁺ cation to direct LiCl crystal facet engineering—shifting growth from passivating {100} cubes to reversible {111} nanocrystals—via N─H···Cl hydrogen bonds that weaken Al─Cl bonds. This links coordination chemistry to catalytic kinetics and facet control, enabling 2500+ cycles at −40°C and 30 A g⁻¹.
🏷 Li-Cl2 battery · crystal facet engineering · electronic polarization · coordination cation · cryogenic operation
